steps.title: Pack for the trip
steps.say: Bring an iron pickaxe or better, a spare pickaxe, food, torches and a water bucket. A weaker pickaxe breaks diamond ore but gives you nothing.

steps.title: Turn on coordinates
steps.say: In your world settings, turn on Show Coordinates. The middle number is Y, and it tells you how high or deep you are.

steps.title: Dig down safely
steps.say: Dig down like a staircase, never straight under your feet. Digging straight down can drop you into a cave or into lava.

steps.title: Stop at minus 53
steps.say: Stop when Y says minus 53. Diamonds are common there, and the lava that fills the deepest caves stays below your feet.

steps.title: Watch for lava
steps.say: Lava can still show up down here. Pour water from your bucket onto it to turn it into obsidian or cobblestone.

steps.title: Dig long tunnels
steps.say: Dig a long, flat tunnel 2 blocks high and 1 block wide. Place torches as you go so you can see and fewer monsters spawn.

steps.title: Avoid the sculk
steps.say: If your tunnel opens into a cave covered in sculk, turn back and dig somewhere else. Sculk shriekers there can call the Warden, a very strong monster.

steps.title: Mine the diamonds
steps.say: When you find diamond ore, mine the blocks around it first so no diamond can fall into lava. Each ore gives 1 diamond.
